summary: Iteration 12: Verified new Premium/Coin section end-to-end. Backend now exposes 4 packages (p100=500 / p200=900 / p300=1200 popular / p500=1900), sbp_phone='+79783069381', recipient_name='Al Amin Dewan', and banks=[sberbank, tbank]. POST /coins/checkout accepts bank Literal (sberbank|tbank), stores it on the transaction, and returns 422 on invalid bank. Admin /admin/settings still returns masked view only (sbp_phone_masked, last4). Frontend PremiumPage renders 4 pkg cards with correct testids + POPULAR badge on p300, SBP info card with copyable phone (clipboard write verified) + recipient, amber-bordered rules-box with heading and rule-1/rule-2, bank-selector defaulting to sberbank and toggling to tbank, pay-modal subtitle correctly showing 'через T-Bank (Тинькофф)' when tbank selected, QR + copy + open-bank + polling status, and pay-success overlay with confetti after ~10s auto-confirm crediting 200 coins.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _try_auto_confirm() unconditionally overwrites tx.bank with 'Sberbank' on success (line 963). This clobbers the user-selected bank (e.g. 'tbank' becomes 'Sberbank' post-confirmation). Recommend removing that $set for 'bank' so the user's chosen sending bank is preserved for reporting/history.
server.py exceeds 1343 lines — consider splitting routes (coins, admin, auth) into separate modules per the >700-line guideline.
